items.title: 【ssh の仕組み #2】ssh が切れたあと、謎の文字が止まらない
Skills Are the New npm [AAIF Bengaluru]
items.summary: Agent Skills let anyone ship instructions and scripts that run inside an AI agent, with its shell, files and credentials. In early 2026, attackers turned skill marketplaces into a malware channel: hundreds of malicious skills, fake "prerequisite" lures, typosquatted publishers, and payloads that later moved off-registry to slip past scanners. This talk threat-models the skill supply chain, breaks down the attack techniques seen in the wild, and live-demos credential theft, a detection gate, a rug-pull update and signature verification with OpenSSF Model Signing. It closes with honest false-positive numbers, the detections that survive evasion, and an incident-response playbook for when a bad skill gets through.
